Properties:%s
mc_talking.debug.not_citizen: Target must be a MineColonies citizen.
mc_talking.debug.not_player: Command must be executed by a player.
mc_talking.debug.no_colony_specified: Specify a colony ID or execute near a colony.
mc_talking.debug.no_colony_found: Could not find a colony for you. Specify a colony ID.
mc_talking.debug.prompt_triggered: Started low-priority session for %s with prompt: "%s"
mc_talking.debug.memory_disabled: Citizen memory is disabled in config.
mc_talking.debug.memory_empty: No memories stored for this citizen.
yacl3.config.mc_talking:config.colonyEve: How long (in seconds) colony lifecycle events (births, deaths, job changes, building changes) appear in citizen prompts. Set to 0 to disable.
yacl3.config.mc_talking:config.enableCol: If enabled, citizens reference neighboring colonies and their diplomatic standing (allies, enemies, etc.) in conversations.
If enabled, citizens occasionally mention colony milestones (buildings built, mobs killed, etc.) in their idle mumbles and conversations.
yacl3.config.mc_talking:config.geminiApi: Gemini API key used to authenticate all AI requests. If empty, all functionality is disabled.
yacl3.config.mc_talking:config.currentAi: Model used for live Gemini WebSocket conversations.
Preferred response language. If players ask to speak in another language, the AI will for their session.
yacl3.config.mc_talking:config.respondIn: If disabled, citizens ignore your microphone while you are in a voice chat group.
yacl3.config.mc_talking:config.continueW: When enabled, citizens will continue wandering normally while talking to a player. When disabled (default), they stand still for the duration of the conversation.
yacl3.config.mc_talking:config.sendMumbl: If enabled, text messages from mumbling and citizen-to-citizen conversations will also be sent to nearby players in chat.
yacl3.config.mc_talking:config.maxConcur: Maximum simultaneous foreground Gemini Live sessions. The default is conservative for AI Studio free-tier usage. Player conversations can evict ambient sessions, but never other players.
Maximum background Gemini Live sessions used by memory compaction and greeting pregeneration. Keep this low on the free tier so background work does not consume interactive capacity.
yacl3.config.mc_talking:config.maxConver: If you move farther than this many blocks from your active citizen, the player conversation ends automatically.
Output mode for normal live sessions: TEXT, AUDIO, or TEXT_AND_AUDIO.
yacl3.config.mc_talking:config.sendError: If enabled, players with OP level receive Gemini runtime errors in chat; otherwise errors are only logged.
yacl3.config.mc_talking:config.disabledT: Function-call tool names to block from the AI. Disabled tools are removed from the tool list sent to Gemini.
yacl3.config.mc_talking:config.enableCon: Stores conversation memory summaries when sessions end and enables transcript capture for memory generation. This consumes additional free-tier quota; disable it if you are frequently rate-limited. AIs can still remember important events mid-conversation using the 'add_event_to_memory' tool.
yacl3.config.mc_talking:config.enableCit: Allows citizens to talk to each other without direct player speech input randomly.
yacl3.config.mc_talking:config.conversat: LIVE_WEBSOCKETS: Two Gemini Live sessions feed audio to each other in real time. FLASH_TTS: Flash generates a script, then TTS renders multi-speaker audio; the preview TTS model has stricter free-tier limits. AUTO (default): tries Flash+TTS first and falls back to Live WebSockets when rate-limited or unavailable.
yacl3.config.mc_talking:config.enableRan: If enabled, nearby citizen pairs can start autonomous conversations at intervals. Requires citizen-to-citizen conversations to be enabled. Also players must not have muted their sound.
yacl3.config.mc_talking:config.randomCon: Per-check chance for an eligible nearby citizen to start a random citizen-to-citizen conversation.
How often the server checks for random citizen-to-citizen conversations. 20 ticks = 1 second.
yacl3.config.mc_talking:config.mumblingC: Per-check chance that an eligible nearby citizen starts mumbling to themselves.
yacl3.config.mc_talking:config.citizenIn: Base scan radius around players for mumbling, citizen-initiated contact, and greetings. Random citizen conversations use twice this range.
yacl3.config.mc_talking:config.mumblingC: How often the server scans for mumbling opportunities near players. 20 ticks = 1 second.
yacl3.config.mc_talking:config.enableCit: Allows urgent citizens to proactively call out to nearby players without being prompted first.
yacl3.config.mc_talking:config.citizenCo: Base per-check chance for urgent contact. Multiplied by an urgency score from happiness, sickness, hunger, health, and homelessness.
How often the server checks whether urgent citizens should initiate contact. 20 ticks = 1 second.
yacl3.config.mc_talking:config.citizenCa: Base weight for casual greetings. Even content citizens without urgent needs get this small chance to wave or say hello. Multiplied by citizenContactBaseChance.
yacl3.config.mc_talking:config.enablePla: If true, the mod will pregenerate personalized player greetings for frequent citizen-player pairs in the background.
yacl3.config.mc_talking:config.playerGre: Distance in blocks within which a citizen will trigger their pregenerated player greeting on first approach.
yacl3.config.mc_talking:config.enableUrg: Walk to Player on Urgent Contact
When enabled, urgent citizens walk toward you over a larger search range, follow you until close, then auto-start the conversation. They stop following when the need resolves.
yacl3.config.mc_talking:config.urgentCon: Extended scan radius (in blocks) for finding citizens with urgent needs when walk-to-player is enabled.
yacl3.config.mc_talking:config.blockingT: Extra urgency weight for citizens stuck on a task (missing tools/items). Higher values make them much more likely to call for help.
yacl3.config.mc_talking:config.playerUrg: Minimum time between urgent citizen contacts for the same player, preventing multiple citizens from calling out at once. Set to 0 to disable.
yacl3.config.mc_talking:config.playerAdd: Minimum time between any two unprompted lines citizens address to you: walking up with a need, casual greetings and pregenerated greetings all share it. Set to 0 to disable.
yacl3.config.mc_talking:config.citizenUr: Minimum time before the same citizen walks up to a player about a need again. Set to 0 to disable.
yacl3.config.mc_talking:config.citizenCo: Cooldown after an automatic session ends before that citizen can be auto-selected again (mumbling, urgent contact, or citizen-to-citizen). Set to 0 to disable.
yacl3.config.mc_talking:config.raidTraum: How long citizens express trauma in their prompts after a raid ends. During this window their speech reflects distress and memories of the attack. Set to 0 to disable.
yacl3.config.mc_talking:config.enableCom: Citizens mention a new problem (no home, no job, sickness, idling at work) in passing, complain after a while and make demands if it lasts. Durations are the colony days MineColonies already counts. Happiness values are not changed.
yacl3.config.mc_talking:config.complaint: Colony days a problem must last before a passing remark becomes a complaint.
Colony days a problem must last before a complaint becomes a demand.
yacl3.config.mc_talking:config.youngColo: While the colony is younger than this many days, citizens only mention housing problems in passing.
yacl3.config.mc_talking:config.enablePer: If enabled, each citizen is randomly assigned a personality archetype (e.g. Optimist, Grump, Gossip) that persistently shapes how they speak.
yacl3.config.mc_talking:config.personali: Archetype: Optimist
Upbeat and hopeful; finds the bright side of everything. Turn off to keep it out of the random pool; citizens that already have it keep it.
Archetype: Grump
Irritable and blunt; complains readily but is not cruel. Turn off to keep it out of the random pool; citizens that already have it keep it.
Archetype: Stoic
Reserved and factual; shows little emotion. Turn off to keep it out of the random pool; citizens that already have it keep it.
Archetype: Gossip
Sociable; loves sharing what other colonists are up to. Turn off to keep it out of the random pool; citizens that already have it keep it.
Archetype: Anxious
Worries a lot, hedges statements and asks for reassurance. Turn off to keep it out of the random pool; citizens that already have it keep it.
Archetype: Boastful
Proud; brags about their work and skills. Turn off to keep it out of the random pool; citizens that already have it keep it.
Archetype: Timid
Soft-spoken and apologetic; easily flustered. Turn off to keep it out of the random pool; citizens that already have it keep it.
Archetype: Philosophical
Reflective; ponders the deeper meaning of everyday things. Turn off to keep it out of the random pool; citizens that already have it keep it.
Archetype: Sarcastic
Dry, deadpan humour; witty rather than mean. Turn off to keep it out of the random pool; citizens that already have it keep it.
Archetype: Dramatic
Theatrical; exaggerates every event. Turn off to keep it out of the random pool; citizens that already have it keep it.
Archetype: Nurturing
Caring and warm; asks how others are doing first. Turn off to keep it out of the random pool; citizens that already have it keep it.
Archetype: Competitive
Treats everything as a friendly contest. Turn off to keep it out of the random pool; citizens that already have it keep it.
Archetype: Curious
Inquisitive; asks lots of questions. Turn off to keep it out of the random pool; citizens that already have it keep it.
Archetype: Nostalgic
Sentimental; often recalls how things used to be. Turn off to keep it out of the random pool; citizens that already have it keep it.
Archetype: Superstitious
Sees omens, luck and curses everywhere. Turn off to keep it out of the random pool; citizens that already have it keep it.
yacl3.config.mc_talking:config.customPer: Freeform personality descriptions added to the assignment pool. Each entry is a plain-English instruction injected into the citizen's system prompt. Example: 'Always speak in rhyming couplets.'
yacl3.config.mc_talking:config.enablePre: If true, enables pregeneration of citizen voices. That way AI will generate greetings / exclaims in the background and dynamically play them
yacl3.config.mc_talking:config.pregenera: Distance within which pregenerated greetings can be played. If a citizen has a pregenerated greeting and you come within this distance, the greeting will play automatically without needing to start a conversation.
yacl3.config.mc_talking:config.threatPla: Minimum time in milliseconds between automatic threat audio plays for the same citizen. Set to 0 to disable.
yacl3.config.mc_talking:config.maxPregen: Maximum number of cached pregenerated greetings stored per citizen. Oldest greetings are discarded when this limit is reached.
yacl3.config.mc_talking:config.maxGreeti: Maximum number of pregenerated citizen-to-citizen greetings that may play in a single tick interval. Increase only if you have a very large colony and want more ambient chatter.
yacl3.config.mc_talking:config.citizenVo: Marks the citizens voice channel as a whisper, which has a smaller default radius
The distance at which the citizen's voice can be heard. Only applies if the value is non 0.
yacl3.config.mc_talking:config.speechFlo: One Voice at a Time Radius

Citizens wait with greetings, mumbling, rumors and addon lines while a player within this many blocks already hears another citizen speaking or is in a conversation. Set to 0 to let everyone talk at once.
yacl3.config.mc_talking:config.otherCiti: While you talk to a citizen, other citizens' voices fade to this volume for you (0 to 1). Only affects what you hear. Set to 1 to turn it off.
yacl3.config.mc_talking:config.enableRum: If enabled, citizens share memories with each other as rumors, creating a living information ecosystem where news spreads through the colony.
yacl3.config.mc_talking:config.rumorMill: How often the server checks for rumor propagation between nearby citizens. 20 ticks = 1 second.
Maximum distance in blocks for rumor propagation between citizens.
Per-check chance that a rumor is shared between an eligible pair of nearby citizens.
Maximum number of rumor propagations per tick to bound server cost.
yacl3.config.mc_talking:config.enableRum: If enabled, citizens voice rumors aloud when a player is nearby.
yacl3.config.mc_talking:config.showGossi: When a citizen passes on a rumor or news while you watch, both stop and turn to each other for a moment, and a subtitle tells you what is going on. Rumors stay secret until you ask.
yacl3.config.mc_talking:config.rumorTalk: Per-propagation chance that a rumor is spoken aloud when a player is in range.
Maximum distance in blocks from the source citizen for a player to witness a voiced rumor.
yacl3.config.mc_talking:config.maxRumors: Maximum rumors a citizen remembers. Oldest are discarded first.
How many rumors appear in the citizen system prompt. Set to 0 to disable.
yacl3.config.mc_talking:config.enableBro: If enabled, players can ask citizens to broadcast messages across the colony. The message spreads from citizen to citizen over time.
yacl3.config.mc_talking:config.broadcast: How often the server checks for broadcast propagation. 20 ticks = 1 second.
Maximum number of broadcast propagations per tick to bound server cost.
Maximum distance in blocks between citizens for a broadcast to propagate. Broadcasts spread through proximity like rumors.
yacl3.config.mc_talking:config.maxBroadc: How many recent broadcasts to include in a citizen's prompt. Set to 0 to disable.
Maximum number of broadcasts stored per citizen. Oldest are discarded when limit is reached.
yacl3.config.mc_talking:config.enableBro: If enabled, citizens announce broadcasts aloud when a player is nearby.
yacl3.config.mc_talking:config.broadcast: Maximum distance in blocks for a player to hear a citizen announce a broadcast aloud.
yacl3.config.mc_talking:config.configPre: Sets the session limits and how often citizens talk on their own, all at once. Free Tier is the default and fits a free AI Studio key. Paid Key allows more sessions and more chatter. Quiet Colony keeps citizens silent unless a player talks to them. Changing one of those settings afterwards switches this to Custom.
yacl3.config.mc_talking:config.enableLiv: When Flash-Lite's daily quota is used up or it fails, write conversation memories, compaction and addon text with the cheap Live model instead. The Live model has no daily limit on the free tier, but uses one background Live session while it runs.
yacl3.config.mc_talking:config.memoryMod: How memory compaction is performed. LIVE uses a text-only WebSocket session. FLASH uses the Gemini Flash API.
yacl3.config.mc_talking:config.enableMem: If enabled, citizen memories will be periodically compacted and summarized to prevent unbounded growth.
yacl3.config.mc_talking:config.memoryCom: How often the server checks for memory compaction candidates. 20 ticks = 1 second.
Maximum number of individual events before compaction is triggered for a citizen.
yacl3.config.mc_talking:config.enableAmb: If enabled, limits how many ambient lines (greetings, mumbles, voiced rumors/broadcasts, random citizen-to-citizen conversations, addon ambient lines) each player can hear within the rolling window. When a nearby player is over budget the line is skipped entirely so a crowd of citizens cannot all talk over each other. Urgent contacts, player-started conversations, and controlled/meeting sessions are always exempt.
yacl3.config.mc_talking:config.ambientSp: Maximum number of ambient lines a player may hear within the rolling window before further ambient lines near them are skipped.
Length in seconds of the rolling window used to count ambient lines heard by a player.

Distance in blocks within which a player is considered to hear an ambient line for budget purposes. An ambient line is skipped entirely if any player within this range of the speaking citizen is over budget.
mc_talking.conversation_hint.quota_excee: Voice limit reached · Try again later
mc_talking.conversation_hint.urgent_walk: On the way to a conversation
yacl3.config.mc_talking:config.showConve: Show small conversation icons above nearby visible citizens.
Show readable conversation feedback when looking at a citizen.
yacl3.config.mc_talking:config.reducedCo: Keep speech icons static and turn off mouth movement and added head and hand gestures.
yacl3.config.mc_talking:config.showConve: Animate built-in adult citizen mouths with received voice audio. Custom skins and helmets retain their original faces.
mc_talking.conversation_creator.c2c_disa: Citizen-to-citizen conversations are disabled in the config

mc_talking.debug.speech_capture.started: Speech capture started for up to %s s. Speak now.
mc_talking.debug.speech_capture.players_: Only a player can run a speech capture.
yacl3.config.mc_talking:config.enableCha: While you talk to a citizen, chat lines starting with the prefix below go to that citizen instead of server chat. /citizen_chat on sends every line. Helps players without a microphone.
yacl3.config.mc_talking:config.chatToCit: Chat lines starting with this go to the citizen you are talking to. Leave empty to only use /citizen_chat on.
mc_talking.chat_to_citizen.rate_limited: Slow down, the citizen is still listening. Try again in a few seconds.
mc_talking.chat_to_citizen.too_long: That is too long for the citizen (at most %s characters).
mc_talking.chat_to_citizen.all_on: Every chat line now goes to the citizen you are talking to. Turn it off with /citizen_chat off.
mc_talking.chat_to_citizen.all_off: Only chat lines starting with "%s" go to the citizen you are talking to.
